scenes.text: Percent means out of 100. Multiply the whole amount by the fraction represented by the percentage.
Find 20 percent of 40. The answer is 8. 20 percent equals 20/100, so 40 times 20/100 equals 8.
A group at a farm has 60 learners; 10 percent joined an activity. How many joined? Pause the video and think.
A group at a farm has 60 learners; 10 percent joined an activity. How many joined? The answer is 6. 10 percent equals 10/100, so 60 times 10/100 equals 6.
